Two-panel comparative diagram. Left panel (Addition Polymerization): Three molecules of ethene (CH2=CH2) with plus signs between them, an arrow pointing to a continuous polymer chain segment showing only single bonds [...-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-...]. Right panel (Condensation Polymerization): A square block molecule ending with two -OH groups plus a round block molecule ending with two -H groups. An arrow points to an alternating chain of square and round blocks, with small H2O molecules dropping out of the connections.
